title: import_assembly_stats_v1 — manifest contract for BUSCO+asmstats imports
description: Validates POST /api/actions when type='import_assembly_stats'. Reads a single per-haplotype assembly_stats.json (or compatible) and emits an assembly_stats_v1 envelope. Source pipeline: BUSCO single-copy + asmstats + custom T2T checker.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the assembly stats JSON.

haplotype.description: Override haplotype id (e.g. 'Gar' or 'Mac') when not present in the file.
